## User-visible change

Describe what changes and why. Link the issue (for example, `Closes #123` if this PR completes it).

## How I checked it

- [ ] Relevant automated checks passed (give exact commands/results or say they are not yet configured).
- [ ] I tried the changed workflow manually where UI or filesystem behavior is involved (OS, input, steps).
- [ ] I checked that errors, unsaved work, and external file changes are handled where relevant.

## Compatibility and rights

Note any changes to file format, saved state, keyboard behavior, dependencies, third-party assets, or licences. Write `None` if none apply. Do not include private source material in screenshots or fixtures.
